propositions: The .reconciler-* gitattributes strip arm in init.py is permanently unreachable because the reconciler phase-gate moved to refs/reconciler/* and the store already converged the line deletion.
The _RETIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES constant and associated strip logic (init.py:69 and 600-616) must be deleted as approved for early removal (pre-1.0 pass #3).
The gitattributes ensure-unit is now create-only; the create arm still writes .bridge_state/* merge=ours carve-out and must remain functional.

Test coverage must be retargeted: test_gitattributes_migration_strips_retired_reconciler_line is deleted, and drift-matrix tests shift from 'committed file carries retired line' to 'no committed .gitattributes at all' scenario.
The removal is internal store convergence with no user-facing input surface, so no deprecation registry or tombstone row is required.
